site.name: Open-Lab Teststand
site.notes: Isolated RF test with permitted frequencies and suitable attenuation/load

tests.title: Registration and deregistration
tests.expected: Both terminals register, appear on the correct TBS and deregister cleanly.

tests.title: Group attach, group call, late entry and floor change
tests.expected: Group affiliation is visible; both terminals receive the call; late entry works; speaker changes are tracked.

tests.title: Individual simplex call
tests.expected: Call setup, speech path, floor handling and release succeed in both directions.

tests.title: SDS Type 4 and status delivery
tests.expected: Individual and group SDS arrive once; delivery state and report correlation are correct.

tests.title: SNDCP context and IPv4 packet data
tests.expected: PDP context activates, assigned IPv4 is stable, UDP echo and WAP test page work, context returns to standby.

tests.title: Call restore during site movement or controlled TBS restart
tests.expected: The managed call is restored without duplicate legs; media resumes and the old context is removed.

tests.title: Recorder integrity
tests.expected: Frame count, speaker metadata, timestamps and SHA-256 verification match the observed call.
